title: Metabolomics Lipid Extraction Protocol
author: Nicholas Sherman
materials: Recover the Lower phase to new clean Eppendorf
Before running, add 10 µL of Avanti Splash Lipidomix to each sample as internal standard and dry samples under gentle stream of N2 using a Recti-VapTM Evaporator (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at 40°C

steps.title: Prepare liquid sample
steps.instruction: To each 100 µL sample add 750 µL of –20 °C cold chloroform:methanol (2:1) mixture and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Shake tubes vigorously for 30 min at 4 °C in a temperature‑controlled thermal shaker.

steps.title: Add water and separate phases
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL water, shake vigorously, then centrifuge 10 min at 10 000 rpm for phase separation.

steps.title: Remove aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Discard the upper aqueous‑methanolic phase (retain it only if soluble metabolites are needed; see BAF_Protocol_008).

steps.title: Second extraction of organic phase
steps.instruction: To the 500 µL chloroform (organic) phase add 500 µL cold chloroform:methanol (2:1) mixture, vortex, and shake vigorously for 30 min at 4 °C in the thermal shaker.

steps.title: Finalize lipid extraction
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL water, shake vigorously, centrifuge 10 min at 10 000 rpm, then recover the lower organic phase as a lipid mixture, store it in glass tubes at –80 °C.

steps.title: Transfer to autosampler
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the lipid extract to a borosilicate glass insert placed inside a screw‑capped glass autosampler vial (Agilent).

steps.title: Prepare solid or tissue sample
steps.instruction: Place frozen tissue slice, lyophilized stool, or cell pellet in a reinforced tube; for cell pellets mix with 50–100 µL water transfer solution to suspend cells.

steps.title: Bead‑mill disruption
steps.instruction: Add 5 stainless‑steel balls and 750 µL –20 °C cold chloroform:methanol (2:1) mixture; disrupt with Fisher Bead Mill 24 at 5 m/s for 20 s, 3 cycles, with a 10 s dwell/pause between runs.

steps.title: Post‑bead‑mill extraction
steps.instruction: Shake the tubes vigorously for 30 min at 4 °C, add 400 µL water, shake, centrifuge 10 min at 10 000 rpm, discard the upper aqueous phase, then repeat steps “Second extraction of organic phase”, “Finalize lipid extraction”, and “Transfer to autosampler” on the recovered lower phase.
